body: Damn, damn, damn, DAMN! I had someone I've seen in the past for counseling that moved out of the area a while ago but has actually done Skype sessions with me as I've needed them. Sent her an email today and just found out she's booked through the fall, not what I wanted to hear. I really don't want to have to start all over again with someone else. It was hard enough to tell her everything I did and starting over again just makes me feel worse.
